app.title: Neljän suora
app.tagline: Four berries in a row – against friends or bots

crash.title: Something broke
crash.body: The game ran into an unexpected error. Reload the page to continue.

start.slow: The server may be waking from hibernation. This can take a moment.
start.errorBody: Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.
start.wakingSlow: The server was sound asleep. Waking up can take about a minute.
start.wakeFailed: The server has not answered yet – you can still try.
start.kicked: You were removed from the game because your turn time ran out.
start.nicknameCharacters: The nickname has characters that cannot be used
start.hostLeft: The game's creator left, so the game was closed
start.notOpen: The game is no longer open
start.serverFull: The server is full – try again in a moment
start.resumeBody: Your seat in the game is still held.
start.resumeGone: The game can no longer be continued
start.invited: You have been invited to a game
start.botsBody: The bot plays at once, offline too.
start.friendsBody: You get an invite link for your friends. Empty seats can be filled with bots.

game.copyFallback: Copy this line into the bug report:
game.linkLabel: Game {{id}}. Tap to share the game link.

errors.NOT_SEATED: You are not in this game
errors.WRONG_PHASE: That cannot be done right now
errors.generic: The move did not go through. Try again.
errors.NOT_KICKABLE: This player cannot be removed now
errors.TURN_NOT_EXPIRED: The player's time is not up yet
errors.NOT_HOST: Only the game's creator can start the game
errors.NOT_A_BOT: There is no bot in that seat
errors.NOT_SPECTATOR: Only a spectator can change the speed
errors.PEOPLE_PLAYING: The speed can only change while only bots play
errors.SERVER_FULL: The server is full – try again in a moment
errors.AUTOPLAYING: The bot is playing your turn – take it back first
errors.NOT_BOT_RUNNER: Another player is computing the bots’ moves now
errors.NOT_BOT_SEAT: No bot plays in that seat
errors.TOO_MANY_PLAYERS: Not every player fits in this game

waiting.title: Waiting room
waiting.waitingFor: Waiting for {{name}} to start the game
waiting.leaveConfirm: The game closes for everyone. Leave?

leave.confirm: Leave the game? Your berries stay on the board, but you no longer play.

spectate.lateInvite: The game had already started – you are watching it

tips.goal: Get four berries in a row – across, up or diagonally.
tips.place: Tap a column – the berry drops to the bottom.
tips.resetDone: Tips will show in the next game.

autoplay.playing: The bot plays for you. You can take the turn back at any time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.soundsNote: A short sound when your turn begins.
settings.turnTitleNote: While the game is in the background, the tab title says your turn has begun.
settings.vibrationNote: A short vibration when your turn begins.
settings.deviceOnly: Settings are saved on this device only.
